title: High Time for Heroes
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie sail the Nile in 1850 to meet Florence Nightingale and learn a third secret of greatness — and a brave rescue makes them heroes, too! 💡

q.en: Where do Jack and Annie travel in this story?
q.zh: 在这个故事里，杰克和安妮穿越到了哪里？

options.en: the Crimea by the Black Sea

explain.en: Jack and Annie land in a sycamore tree on the River Nile in Thebes, Egypt, in the year 1850, across from the Temple of Luxor.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮降落在 1850 年埃及底比斯尼罗河畔的一棵悬铃木上，正对着卢克索神庙。

q.en: Which famous person do Jack and Annie hope to meet on this mission?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮希望在这次任务中见到哪位名人？

options.en: Countess von Kensky, in a place far away

explain.en: Merlin's scroll sends them to find Florence Nightingale, the woman soldiers will later call the Lady with the Lamp and who becomes the founder of modern nursing.
explain.zh: 梅林的卷轴让他们去寻找弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔——后来士兵们称她为“提灯女神”，她也成为现代护理事业的奠基人。

q.en: What animal does the Countess von Kensky carry with her?
q.zh: 冯·肯斯基伯爵夫人随身带着什么动物？

options.en: a white dove from the park

explain.en: The Countess, who is from Budapest, travels with Koku, a baby baboon from the Sudan in Africa. She later asks Jack and Annie to babysit Koku for the afternoon.
explain.zh: 伯爵夫人来自布达佩斯，她带着科库——一只来自非洲苏丹的幼狒狒。后来她请杰克和安妮下午帮忙照看科库。

q.en: To rescue Koku from the top of a cliff, what do Jack and Annie use the magic mist to become?
q.zh: 为了把科库从悬崖顶上救下来，杰克和安妮用魔法雾把自己变成了什么？

explain.en: When Koku is trapped on the cliff, Jack uncorks Merlin's magic mist and they wish to be great rock climbers for one hour so they can climb up and bring her down.
explain.zh: 科库被困在悬崖上时，杰克打开梅林的魔法雾，他们许愿要当一小时的攀岩高手，好爬上去把它救下来。

q.en: What is the third secret of greatness they learn from Florence?
q.zh: 他们从弗洛伦斯那里学到的第三个“伟大的秘密”是什么？

explain.en: Florence says she believes deep in her heart that one's life must have meaning and purpose. The Ring of Truth glows, and Jack writes 'meaning and purpose' as the third secret under humility and hard work.
explain.zh: 弗洛伦斯说，她从心底相信，一个人的生命必须有意义和目标。真理之戒亮了起来，杰克便把“意义与目标”写在“谦逊”和“刻苦努力”下面，作为第三个秘密。

q.en: What happens to Jack and Annie as they climb back down the cliff?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮在从悬崖往下爬的时候，发生了什么？

options.en: they lose their two donkeys in the dark, in a place far away
options.zh: 他们在黑暗中弄丢了两头驴，在很远很远的地方

options.en: Jack hurts his shoulder, Annie her ankle
options.zh: 杰克伤了肩膀，安妮扭了脚踝

options.en: they both come down with a bad fever
they each break a leg in the fall
options.zh: 两人摔下来都摔断了腿

explain.en: Halfway down, Jack's grip slips and he falls, dislocating his shoulder; Annie also falls and sprains her ankle. Florence later finds them and cares for their injuries.
explain.zh: 爬到半途，杰克手一滑摔了下去，肩膀脱臼；安妮也摔下来，扭了脚踝。后来弗洛伦斯找到他们，并照料了他们的伤。

q.en: When Florence cares for Jack, what does she make for his hurt arm?
q.zh: 弗洛伦斯照料杰克时，为他的伤臂做了什么？

explain.en: Florence wraps a long piece of cloth around Jack's dislocated shoulder to make a cotton sling while he sleeps, and she bandages Annie's sprained ankle. (The wooden crutch was for Annie's ankle.)
explain.zh: 弗洛伦斯用一长条布把杰克脱臼的肩膀包成棉布吊带——那是趁他熟睡时弄的；她也包扎了安妮扭伤的脚踝。（木制拐杖是给安妮的脚踝用的。）

q.en: What are the Colossi of Memnon that Jack and Annie see on the plain?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮在平原上看到的“门农巨像”是什么？

options.en: a pair of giant camels, as someone else had told it
options.zh: 一对巨大的骆驼，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: The Colossi of Memnon are two gigantic statues of pharaohs on thrones, over 3,000 years old, that once guarded a temple; 'Memnon' means Ruler of the Dawn.
explain.zh: “门农巨像”是两座巨大的法老坐像，已有三千多年历史，曾经守卫着一座神庙；“门农”的意思是“黎明之主”。

q.en: According to the Bickersons, whose single bite holds enough poison to kill twenty people?
q.zh: 据比克森夫妇说，哪一种动物咬一口所含的毒就足以毒死二十个人？

explain.en: Lady Bickerson warns that the black mamba's single bite contains enough poison to kill twenty people — one of the many 'dangers' she claims fill Egypt.
explain.zh: 比克森夫人警告说，黑曼巴蛇咬一口所含的毒就足以毒死二十个人——这是她口中“到处都是危险”的埃及里的其中一种。

q.en: At the end, what does the guide Mustafa refuse to take from Jack?
q.zh: 最后，向导穆斯塔法拒绝从杰克那里收下什么？

options.en: their two donkeys, in a place far away
options.zh: 他们的两头驴，在很远很远的地方

explain.en: When Jack offers his Egyptian coins, Mustafa says no — it is the first word Jack hears him speak: he helped them not for money, but because they needed help.
explain.zh: 当杰克拿出埃及硬币时，穆斯塔法摇头拒绝了——这是杰克听他说的第一句话：他帮忙不是为了钱，而是因为他们需要帮助。
